standard.title: Ready Mixed Paint, Stoving, Red Oxide Zinc Chrome, Priming — Specification (Third Revision) (तैयार मिश्रित पेंट, स्टोविंग, रेड ऑक्साइड जिंक क्रोम, प्राइमिंग — विशिष्टि (तीसरा पुनरीक्षण))
standard.sector: Chemical / Paints, Varnishes and Related Products

sectional_committee.name: Paints, Varnishes and Related Products Sectional Committee

standard.description: This standard prescribes the requirements, chemical formulation parameters, application methods, physical-mechanical testing limits, and sampling protocols for the material commercially known as ready mixed paint, stoving, red oxide zinc chrome, priming, used as a high-integrity anti-corrosive primer in paint systems for protecting steelwork, sheet metal, and industrial machinery under inland, marine, or industrial outdoor/indoor conditions.

certification.description: Voluntary Product Specification under the Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS). However, paint manufacturers are highly encouraged to apply for a BIS license to print the prestigious BIS 'Standard Mark' (ISI Mark) directly on the paint drums and containers. This serves as a certified guarantee of anti-corrosive performance, stoving kinetics, and weather-exposure durability. Compliance with IS 2075 is strictly demanded in major engineering supply contracts, automotive and machinery fabrication tenders, railway coach paint specifications, and defense logistics across India.
requirements: The paint film is formulated to be baked (stoved) to form an incredibly tough, highly cross-linked, and impervious polymer barrier. The baking schedule must be performed at temperatures ranging from 100°C to 150°C (typically 120°C) [2] for approximately 30 minutes [2, 3].
The primer must cure rapidly under heat, showing no soft, tacky, or wet films at the completion of the designated stoving period [2, 4].

The stoved primer film must show exceptional compatibility when overcoated with finishes, including synthetic stoving enamels, showing no signs of lifting, wrinkling, or blistering under subsequent baking [5-8].
After baking, the paint film must dry to a smooth, uniform, and eggshell-flat or semi-gloss finish [5-7, 9] that provides an excellent mechanical key for finishing topcoats.

The pigment must comprise a balanced mixture of high-purity red oxide (iron oxide) for physical barrier protection and zinc chrome pigment to provide active galvanic and passivating corrosion inhibition on metal substrates [4, 10, 11].
Restricts volatile solvent content to limit atmospheric VOC emissions and ensure a high solid-content density of the wet paint [9, 11, 12].
Each container must be legibly and indelibly marked with the manufacturer's name, brand, date of manufacture, batch number, shelf life, and the stoving schedule parameters [13, 14].

All observed or calculated test and analytical values must be mathematically rounded off in accordance with IS 2:1960. The number of significant places retained in the rounded value must match the specified limit.
